description: This file defines the OverlayPanelFactory enum with static methods to create, animate, present, dismiss, and manage overlay panels and windows in a macOS application using AppKit. It includes functions for configuring NSPanel instances, animating NSWindow objects, and handling event monitors.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates and returns an NSPanel configured with specified parameters such as content rectangle, window level, shadow, and mouse events acceptance.

methods.name: animatePresent
methods.description: Animates the presentation of a window from a start rectangle to a target rectangle with fade-in effect.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Animates the window's frame to a specified rectangle.

methods.name: applyFrame
methods.description: Sets the window's frame to a target rectangle, optionally with animation.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles the logic for presenting a window, including initial animation if it's the first presentation, and executes callback functions accordingly.

methods.name: animateDismiss
methods.description: Animates the dismissal of a window by moving and fading out, with a completion callback.

methods.name: animateDismissAndHide
methods.description: Animates dismissing a window and then hides it, executing a callback upon hiding.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventMonitor
methods.description: Removes and clears a global event monitor if present.
